description: A multi-platform network debugging and traffic splitting client based on Mihomo (Clash Meta)
pre_uninstall: if (Get-Service -Name 'BettboxHelperService' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Running' }) { info "If file locks prevent uninstallation, run 'sudo sc stop BettboxHelperService' and 'sudo sc delete BettboxHelperService' manually." }
